description: Defines the ParameterRow class that manages a LoggerData object, representing a row in a parameter list UI, with selection state management.

classes.name: ParameterRow
classes.description: Represents a row in the parameter list UI, encapsulating LoggerData and selection state, with methods to access and modify selection.

methods.name: ParameterRow
methods.description: Constructor initializing ParameterRow with a LoggerData object and checking it's not null.

methods.name: getLoggerData
methods.description: Returns the LoggerData associated with this ParameterRow.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Returns whether this parameter row is selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state for this parameter row and updates the LoggerData accordingly.
